abstract: Maintains cleanroom classification, environmental purge systems, and particulate excursion monitoring records
system_message:
You are Facility engineering lead (FAC). The Facility engineering lead (FAC) manages environmental and physical infrastructure records across candidate packaging facilities, tracking cleanroom certification standards, process gas purging implementations, baseline particulate excursion frequencies, and secondary utility redundancies.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Chilled water loop redundancy（HVAC）
information_points.content:
FAC-HVAC-LIQ：An HVAC mechanical audit of the primary cleanroom central cooling plant confirms that Silicon Saxony Interconnect Fab maintains a redundant chiller loop count of 2 loops.
FAC-HVAC-TKN：An HVAC mechanical audit of the primary cleanroom central cooling plant confirms that Kyushu Advanced Micro-Substrates maintains a redundant chiller loop count of 4 loops.
FAC-HVAC-BJD：An HVAC mechanical audit of the primary cleanroom central cooling plant indicates that Hsinchu Heterogeneous Integration Foundry maintains a redundant chiller loop count of 3 loops.

information_points.title: Maintains cleanroom classification, environmental purge systems, and particulate excursion monitoring records（CLN）
information_points.content:
FAC-CLN-PCI：For Silicon Saxony Interconnect Fab, cleanroom ISO class 4 environmental compliance is validated for the main wafer thinning and ball-grid placement bay under operational loading, and the dedicated cleanroom nitrogen purge system is confirmed activated across FOUP docking and micro-environment wafer transfer tunnels. Airborne particle counter telemetry across substrate dicing and die-attach workcells over the preceding thirty operating days records a daily particulate excursion frequency of 2 events/day.
FAC-CLN-L12：For Hsinchu Heterogeneous Integration Foundry, cleanroom ISO class 4 environmental compliance is verified under operational loading in the main wafer thinning and ball-grid placement bay, and the dedicated cleanroom nitrogen purge system is activated for FOUP docking and micro-environment wafer transfer tunnels. Continuous particle counter telemetry in substrate dicing and die-attach workcells across the preceding thirty operating days reflects a daily particulate excursion frequency of 4 events/day.
FAC-CLN-ARD：For Kyushu Advanced Micro-Substrates, cleanroom ISO class 4 environmental compliance is validated in the main wafer thinning and ball-grid placement bay under operational loading, and the dedicated cleanroom nitrogen purge system is active for FOUP docking and micro-environment wafer transfer tunnels. Continuous airborne particle counter telemetry in substrate dicing and die-attach workcells over the preceding thirty operating days shows a daily particulate excursion frequency of 8 events/day.
